updates.title: CVE-2026-50481: Azure Active Directory Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: A vulnerability in Azure Active Directory allows authorized attackers to modify assumed-immutable data and escalate privileges. Admins should apply patches immediately to prevent unauthorized privilege elevation within their identity infrastructure.

updates.title: CVE-2026-59115: Microsoft Entra Provisioning Service Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: A path traversal vulnerability in Microsoft Entra Provisioning Service (SyncFabric) permits authorized attackers to escalate privileges on the network. This affects identity synchronization workflows and requires immediate patching to prevent unauthorized access.

updates.title: CVE-2026-65668: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: Improper access control in Microsoft Purview eDiscovery allows authorized attackers to escalate privileges over a network. Compliance and legal teams relying on eDiscovery should prioritize patching to maintain secure audit and data control.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft 365 Copilot Web Search Protection
updates.summary: DLP controls now prevent Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from performing external web searches on prompts containing sensitive data, reducing data leakage risks through AI interactions. This capability is rolling out and helps organizations govern generative AI usage in compliance with data protection policies.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: DLP and Information Protection auto-labeling now extend to Google Workspace, Box, Dropbox, Salesforce, ServiceNow, AWS, and Cisco Webex, allowing admins to enforce consistent data protection policies across a broader SaaS ecosystem. This expansion is in development and significantly broadens governance scope beyond Microsoft 365.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Adaptive Scope Evaluation Control with Lifecycle Status
updates.summary: Adaptive Scopes now offer explicit control over lifecycle-state evaluation for recipients and site owners, ensuring policy targeting remains aligned with employee status changes. This feature helps admins maintain accurate scope membership as users join, transfer, or leave the organization.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection Auto-Labeling Scale Increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: Auto-labeling capacity increases from 100,000 to 500,000 files per tenant per day across SharePoint and OneDrive, enabling faster data classification and protection at scale. This helps organizations close labeling gaps and prepare their data estates for Microsoft 365 Copilot.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft 365 Copilot in Government Clouds
updates.summary: DLP protection for Microsoft 365 Copilot is now rolling out to government cloud environments, preventing Copilot from returning responses or using sensitive data from prompts. This ensures organizations in GCC environments can safely adopt Copilot while maintaining compliance requirements.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention Device Health Reporting Dashboard
updates.summary: A new dashboard lets admins monitor device health across all endpoints to ensure readiness for policy updates and quickly identify devices not reporting properly. Rolling out now, this improves visibility into endpoint DLP deployment status and system reliability.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention Guided Diagnostics for Policy Troubleshooting
updates.summary: A new guided diagnostics experience helps users understand why DLP policies trigger, showing which policies matched, evaluation order, and per-condition details. For E5 customers, Copilot-powered insights and recommendations accelerate troubleshooting and policy optimization.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management SharePoint File Archiving under Retention
updates.summary: Admins can now add archiving actions to SharePoint retention policies, moving inactive content to low-cost storage while keeping it discoverable. This extends lifecycle management beyond keep-or-delete decisions and reduces storage costs without compromising compliance.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection Auto-Labeling Per-Policy Coverage Report
updates.summary: A new per-policy coverage report shows how files processed during auto-labeling enforcement compare to the latest simulation snapshot, revealing labeled, unlabeled, and newly processed files. This helps admins track enforcement progress and identify data state changes since simulation.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention SLA-Based Alert Reporting Dashboard
updates.summary: A new out-of-box dashboard tracks DLP alert metrics including mean time to alert, detection, and resolution against custom SLAs for high, medium, and low severity alerts. Admins can monitor operational performance and identify top sensitive information types being exposed.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention Rule-Based Alert Tagging and Auto-Resolution
updates.summary: Admins can now define rules to automatically tag and resolve predictable DLP alerts based on business context—for example, auto-resolving low-severity mail alerts to trusted partners or labeling alerts for routing to specific teams. This reduces alert noise and accelerates triage workflows.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention Network Security Integration with Entra Global Secure Access
updates.summary: DLP now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to inspect text and AI interactions at the network layer, enforcing restrictive actions on sensitive data shared through browsers, apps, APIs, and generative AI platforms. This preview capability prevents data leakage across untrusted cloud and third-party services.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management Unified Alert Experience
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management now combines the Triage Agent and Standard alert dashboards into a single alerts list, allowing analysts to view, preview, and manage both classic and agent-triaged alerts in one location. System-generated notes automatically track status and assignment changes, improving investigation workflow efficiency.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management Expanded User Profile Details from Entra
updates.summary: The unified alert experience now displays additional Microsoft Entra user profile signals including office location, employee type, department, and last working date directly in alert views. This enrichment helps analysts assess risk context more quickly and identify insider threats with organizational context.
